title: My secret to keeping cast iron in great shape
body: So I've been using a really simple trick for my cast iron lately, and it's been a game-changer. After every use, instead of just wiping it down, I let it air dry completely on the stovetop for about fifteen minutes. This really helps get all the moisture out. Then, I give it a light coat of olive oil and let it sit for an hour before wiping off the excess. It makes the seasoning stay much better for longer.
